content: CRAN R CMD check pitfalls with rmarkdown/knitr in Suggests: (1) Both rmarkdown and knitr must be in VignetteBuilder AND Suggests; missing either causes check failure. (2) R CMD build builds vignettes from vignettes/ but R CMD check checks they rebuild from inst/doc/ — data only in vignettes/ is not copied. (3) Pandoc must be available at build time; if rmarkdown unavailable, knitr falls back to knitr::knitr engine. (4) CRAN checks that vignette code is runnable — all packages used in vignettes must be declared in DESCRIPTION. (5) Use --no-build-vignettes and --ignore-vignettes flags for submissions when toolchains unavailable. (6) For PDF output, tinytex must be installed via tinytex:::install_yihui_pkgs(); tlmgr can break if mirrors are out of date. (7) officedown requires rdocx_document() not rmarkdown::word_document() for full flextable support including images and hyperlinks.
